text: Ok you want the list? Fine. Here's the list
1. You chew with your mouth open and you do it now on purpose bc you know it bugs people
2. You cancelled on my mom's 60th for a "job site emergency" and then I saw you at the dome on quinpool that same night
3. Being late is not a personality chris
4. You borrowed my car for a week and gave it back smelling like wet dog and cigarettes and then called me dramatic for mentioning it
5. You never once asked about my dad. Not once. Two years. You asked about your truck like 40 times
Wow
U really sat down and typed that
The car thing was a week and I paid for the detail
And the dome was a wednesday, mom's thing was a saturday, u literally cant keep ur own dates straight
Ur not even going to pretend about the dome
Ok my turn. Since ur keeping score
Go
You are the most selfish person I know. You only call when you need a ride or a loan
You talk about how hard your apprenticeship is like nobody else has ever worked a day
You still haven't paid back the 400 from march. Don't say you did, I checked my etransfers
And you have the worst taste in women. Every single one of them was a mess and you act like it's bad luck
Ok
The 400 was 300 and I paid it in july
And at least I dont pretend every job I had was "management track" when I was folding sweaters at penn square
Wow ok. You went there
At least I kept a job longer than 4 months
The electrician thing is 3 years. Ur the one who got fired from the shoe place lol
I quit. They were cutting hours and the manager was a nightmare
And the sweater thing was a good job, I was good at it
Sure
Had a lady today at bayers lake try to return boots she wore to a wedding. The boots had mud and a red wine stain on them and she wanted a full refund and cried when I said no
And then the manager made me give her a store credit anyway
So yeah. My day was great thanks for asking
Ur day? I was on a roof in hammond plains from 7 to 4 in the wind. My hands are still cold. I'm not even exaggerating
And you're the one who asked for the list lol
I didnt ask u for anything
U sent me the 400 thing first
No u sent the car thing first
Whatever
You still there
Ok you're not going to answer. Fine
You know what the worst part was. You knew about my dad before I told the whole group. You told kayla at the lobster supper and she told everyone at the shower and I had to hear about it from my aunt
You were supposed to be the one person I didn't have to worry about
Ok so ur going to bring that up
U want to talk about who told who. U told lindsay about the thing with my brother's dui and then she told the whole office at the port
U told me it was a secret. Literally said "this stays between us"
Thats different
Ur brother got arrested. That's not the same as my dad
My brother spent 2 nights in a cell and he's been paying for it for a year. U don't get to say its not the same
Ok
I didn't mean it like that
I'm just tired of everyone acting like I'm the one who ruined this
U did say it first though
Both of us did. I'm not saying it to be a jerk
I know
I'm going to bed. Don't text me tomorrow about the boots lady
Wasnt gonna text u about the boots lady lol
For what its worth the store credit was prob the right call. She woulda been back next week
Doesnt make it not a nightmare
My aunt asked me if we're still not talking. Like she wanted me to confirm it
What did u say
That I'm not going to be in a room with u for a while
Ok
My mom asked the same thing. I told her ur the one who sent the list
Lol of course u did
Did ur brother ever pay that lawyer back or is that still a thing
Dont
Ok
Did u even know my dad had the surgery in october
No
I knew about the diagnosis from kayla. I didnt know about the surgery. I should have asked
Yeah
Its been 2 years chris
I know
Hes doing ok tho? Like now
Hes ok. Hes getting annoyed at the physio like everyone else who has to do physio
Lol
Im going to my cousins for dinner. Not that u asked
Didnt ask
For the record I didnt tell kayla about ur dad
I knew but I didnt tell anyone
Then who did
Idk. Ask ur aunt
My aunt heard it from kayla
So
So ur going round in circles lol
Dont do that
Ok
I'm not saying ur lying
I'm saying it was supposed to be u and I didnt have to check
Shift at bayers lake 11 to 7. Of course it's the one day
Sorry
Not sorry for the store, sorry for ur sunday lol
Kid knocked over the whole candle display by the till. Glass everywhere. The mom just kept walking
Didn't even turn around
Did u get cut
Swept it up. Got 2 fingers. I'm fine
Dont make it a thing
Wasnt gonna. Did u put a bandaid on
Obviously
Asked my aunt about kayla. She doesnt remember who she heard it from. Just says "around"
So thats useless
Told u
Ur allowed to not know who it was. It doesnt have to be me
Did I say it was u
U said "its supposed to be u"
Ok
Thats not the same as saying u told her
I know what it means
My brother got the last payment in to the lawyer. Oct 14. He wrote it on his fridge lol
Figured u asked and I was a dick about it
Ok. I'm glad he got it done
He was always so loud about the job thing when he was 19 lol
He still is
Dads home from physio. Hes mad the guy made him walk the hallway 20 times
Mom says tell u hi. Not that ur getting a hi
Tell her hi back
Tell him the physio guy is right. Dont say I said that
Lol
Im going to bed
Dont text me about the candles
Wasnt gonna lol
